thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: PD service=redwood-serving-us-west-2a alert=High 5xx rate (p95 error rate > 5%) across redwood-inference-az2 clusters. Probe: /v1/generate errors spiked at 03:12 UTC.
PagerDuty: Incident created and paging: SRE Pager -> oncall-sre.
Maya R: ack'd on PD. I'm on it. grabbing logs and health checks. :eyes:
oncall-sre: thanks. quick check: any ongoing deploys?
Jordan L: no deploys in the last 30m. I'm starting capacity checks and routing status.
Maya R: pulling cluster status now — noticed node intensiveness on pool gpu-pool-az2-1. KV cache eviction rates high.
Maya R: logs: `rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = Queue backlog > 120s` repeated.
oncall-sre: looks like a local capacity saturation rather than external network. can we divert traffic to az1/az3?
Jordan L: routing policy currently weight: az2=70, az1=20, az3=10. I'm going to reduce az2 weight to 40 temporarily.
ops-rotation-bot: ran traffic-weight update -> {az2:40, az1:35, az3:25} (applied).
Support Team: got a couple customers reporting timeouts, flagging high impact for a subset of requests with long context lengths.
Maya R: starting controlled fallback: enable model-variant fallback to quantized-variant on az2 for long-seq requests to reduce memory pressure.
Maya R: command executed: ```sh
# enable fallback rule
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/routes/fallback \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","condition":"ctx_len>2048","fallback_model":"gpt-q-1.3b","scope":"az2"}'
```
oncall-sre: good. also bumping instance count for gpu-pool-az2-1 by +2 (hot-add).
Jordan L: autoscaler seems stuck on a couple nodes, manually triggering scale up: ```
kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/gpu-pool-az2-1 -n serving
```
incident-bot: note: autoscaler event at 03:14 UTC -> scale attempt queued.
PagerDuty: Maya R acknowledged at 03:13 UTC. Escalation suppressed.
Maya R: after scaling attempt, CPU on new nodes shows slow join; suspect NIC provisioning delays. vendor network logs show transient fabric flaps in the AZ.
oncall-sre: if fabric flaps persist we'll need to fail traffic from az2 entirely. Jordan, prepare failover playbook steps.
Jordan L: copying playbook excerpt: ```
# failover playbook snippet
1) set routing weight az2=0
2) ensure fallback model routes active in other AZs
3) drain pods in az2 gracefully
4) notify customers in 15m if degraded
```
Support Team: preparing customer comms draft for impacted tenants (high latency/timeouts).
Maya R: running targeted KV cache purge for hot prefixes to free memory: ```
redis-cli -h kvcache-az2 --eval 'purge_hot.lua' 1000
```
oncall-sre: purge completed, eviction rate dropped ~60%. p95 latency dropping from 1.8s to 1.2s on small requests.
Jordan L: network vendor reports intermittent NIC resets 03:10-03:18 UTC in az2 rack B. current ETA unknown.
Maya R: traffic-weight now az2=15, az1=50, az3=35 via controlplane. ops-rotation-bot confirmed.
incident-bot: update: PD note appended: 'Work in progress - scaling and routing changes applied. Monitoring for recovery.'
PagerDuty: auto-reminder suppressed; next escalation at 03:42 UTC if not resolved.
Maya R: running healthcheck sweep across customer-facing endpoints. so far ~70% of requests recovered; long-context paths still problematic but falling.
oncall-sre: Jordan, prep handoff — I need to sleep in 40m. can you take SRE lead if we still have az2 instability?
Jordan L: I can take the handoff. I'll be primary after 04:00 UTC. set PD ack to Jordan.
Maya R: handing off notes: actions done: scaled +2, KV purge, fallback rule enabled, routing adjusted to az2=15. Remaining: monitor vendor fabric, consider full az2 drain if flaps continue >10m.
Support Team: sending proactive message to affected customers with mitigation steps and expected timeline.
incident-bot: summary (03:20 UTC): root-cause suspected NIC fabric flaps in us-west-2a causing GPU nodes to lag and queue growth -> resource exhaustion -> elevated 5xx. Actions: scale attempt, KV purge, fallback model activation, routing weight adjustments.
PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Jordan L at 03:58 UTC (handoff).
Jordan L: will keep monitoring for 30m; if error rate stays below threshold we'll start rollback of fallbacks and gradually restore az2 weight.
Maya R: thanks team. filing follow-up postmortem entry and tagging vendor. :+1:
incident-bot: closing note: incident remains open; next update due 04:00 UTC.
